name: Trunk
note: Schematic trunk from the lower ribs to the pelvis, not to scale. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

rectus-abdominis.name: Rectus abdominis
rectus-abdominis.action: Bends the trunk forwards; stops the pelvis tipping forwards

external-oblique.name: External oblique
external-oblique.action: Bends and twists the trunk; braces it

psoas.name: Psoas major
psoas.action: Bends the hip (with the iliacus); steadies the lumbar spine

longissimus.name: Longissimus (erector spinae)
longissimus.action: Extends the back; middle column, the largest

spinalis.name: Spinalis (erector spinae)
spinalis.action: Extends the back; inner column, next to the spine

views.title: Front
views.caption: Trunk from the front, lower ribs to pelvis.

views.title: Front, deep layer
views.caption: Abdominal wall and organs removed: the psoas on each side of the lumbar spine, running down to the thigh.

views.title: Back
views.caption: Lower back from behind: the three columns of the erector spinae on each side of the spine.
